Summary: Timberline is building a ticket-deflection + agent-assist platform for mid-market SaaS support teams. Primary objective is a RAG-backed support agent with a hard latency SLO (p95 end-to-end query + rerank target <= 150ms) and high top-5 quality for reranking (business target: >92% accuracy on labeled prompt set). They expect to index ~30–70M document fragments (50M is our POC number) and run steady-state query volumes ~800–1,200 qps with peaks to 5k qps during enterprise events. Cost sensitivity: want unit cost per query under $0.003 (embeddings + ANN + rerank). Preferred model strategy: open/industry embeddings (mpnet-type) for ANN index, plus a lightweight cross-encoder reranker (distilled) for top-5 reranking. Cust wants transparent kernel/quantization recommendations; interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions to balance cost and top-5 quality.

Notes style: bullets + shorthand below.
- "Latency is non-negotiable" — engineering VP on call 02/18
- Security: require VPC + BYOK KMS; SOC2 required for procurement
- Data residency: US-only for now; persistence retention policy 90 days for cache
- POC asks: 1) Index 50M embeddings (ingest rate + cost), 2) Run 1k qps sustained with p95 <150ms, 3) Show rerank hit-rate on their eval set (50 labeled tickets)
- Technical risks: KV cache size for long contexts, ANN recall drop on short queries, reranker tokenization mismatch causing quality regressions
- Action items: SE (Ravi) to run index-cost sim and provide batching/kv-cache config; AE (Avery) to align procurement timeline; Security follow-up scheduled 03/12 for KMS flow.
- Links: Fireflies calls + Drive deck attached. Gmail threads contain redacted customer PII examples for eval set (we have DPA in place).
